assets.name: skeleton_sword
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ORIGINAL production pixel-art game animation sprite sheet, RGBA transparent.
Create one single skeleton swordsman character animation atlas. This is newly drawn original art, not a copy of any paid sprite pack. Style direction only: Tiny RPG chunky miniature fantasy sprite language, bold 1-logical-pixel black outlines, large skull with two black eye sockets, simplified pale ivory ribs, small steel-blue open helmet, battered small round buckler in left hand, short straight sword in right hand. Slight three-quarter side view FACING RIGHT in every standing pose; same identity, equipment, limb lengths and body size in every cell. Very coarse authentic 32-pixel-character resolution, shown as exact 4x4 pixel blocks on canvas. Hard pixel edges, only 12-16 solid colors, no smooth antialiasing, no painterly detail.
Composition absolutely fixed: square image 1536x1536 pixels. Exactly THREE equal-width columns and SIX equal-height rows. Each invisible grid cell is 512x256 pixels. Exactly ONE sprite inside EACH of the 18 cells. The character body is approximately 128 pixels tall, centered horizontally at local x256, feet consistently touch local y200. Keep arms/weapon/effects wholly within each cell, leave at least 32 transparent pixels at all boundaries. No visible grid, no separators, no text, no labels, no ground shadows, no checkerboard. Actual alpha transparency outside sprites.
Rows top to bottom, each left to right THREE materially DIFFERENT time frames of the SAME action:
Row 1 IDLE: relaxed ready stance; ribs/skull lifted 4px with breathing; settled stance.
Row 2 WALK: right foot forward, left arm forward; neutral passing stance; left foot forward, right arm forward. Visible alternating feet, compact body.
Row 3 ATTACK: sword raised back and shield tucked (anticipation); sword swinging far forward toward RIGHT with a short ivory pixel crescent (contact); sword extended low and body recovered (follow through).
Row 4 HURT: recoil leaning back; off-balance hunched with sword dropped slightly; recover upright. Keep ivory palette, no red duplicate flash.
Row 5 DEATH: knees buckle; torso and skull collapse toward right; pile of disconnected bones, skull and dropped sword on floor. Final pile is low and visibly different from standing poses.
Row 6 SPAWN / SUMMON: small complete bone pile at the feet with three faint lavender square sparks; half-assembled ribs/arms lifting, skull halfway up; fully reassembled ready skeleton with only two fading lavender sparks. Final frame matches idle body size and foot anchor.
Clean sprite atlas only, each pose isolated with transparent gutters. Do not repeat identical sprites across an animation row.

assets.name: skeleton_guard
assets.prompt:
Edit this ORIGINAL skeleton animation sheet into a separate HEAVY SKELETON GUARD animation sheet. Preserve the original coarse pixel sprite drawing style, THREE columns and SIX rows, the character size and each cell's standing foot position. Same skull identity in all 18 cells. Equip every guard pose with a broad dark steel-blue closed helmet with T-shaped opening showing black skull eye sockets, compact plated chest/shoulder armor, a tall rectangular shield and a short thick iron sword. Bigger shield silhouette distinguishes this heavy defender from the light skeleton. Chunky true pixel art, 1-logical-pixel bold black outlines, ivory bones, slate armor with 2 highlight steps, coarse pixel blocks as if 32-40 pixel characters upscaled. No fine painted texture, no microdetail, no antialiasing.
Exactly 3 columns × 6 rows, ONE complete isolated guard in each cell, no extra characters. Keep standing feet at the same local y in each column. Face RIGHT in every standing pose. No background, no floor, no shadow, no checkerboard or text. PNG actual alpha transparency: every gutter and space outside a sprite is exactly alpha zero; no low-opacity colored background noise, no haze, no colored outline halos.
Rows, left to right THREE DIFFERENT actual time frames:
1 IDLE: heavy shield ready; small shoulder/helmet rise; shoulders settle.
2 WALK: right foot forward dragging shield; passing stance; left foot forward. Visible stepping, armor retained.
3 ATTACK: shield braced, sword drawn back; heavy rightward sword cleave, small pale pixel slash; sword low forward recovery and shield returns.
4 HURT: shield knocked aside and torso recoils; kneeling off balance; rises and braces shield.
5 DEATH: buckles to knees; crumples with helmet tilted; low fallen armored bone heap plus dropped shield at the floor.
6 SPAWN/SUMMON: low helmet/shield and bone pile with three lavender square sparks; half assembled skeleton lifting shield; full standing heavy guard with two fading sparks.
Strict transparent gutters, actions never spill into neighbor cells. Preserve original frame layout; replace only the character identity/equipment and action poses with this defender, correcting background alpha noise.

assets.name: skeleton_necro
assets.prompt:
Edit this ORIGINAL skeleton sprite sheet into a distinct NECROMANCER / SPECTRAL SKELETON game animation atlas. Keep the same coarse miniature pixel style, exactly THREE columns by SIX rows and one isolated pose per cell. Replace soldier armor, sword and shield with: pale ivory skull inside a deep pointed dark plum hood, compact dark violet robe with two violet highlight bands, visible bony hands, short ragged robe hem that hides feet, tall crooked staff with a small violet skull crystal on its top held on the LEFT side of the body. Face RIGHT in every live pose. Same skull, hood, body height, staff and costume throughout. NOT a detailed painted fantasy illustration: true chunky 32-40 pixel character aesthetic at large pixel-block scale, thick pure black outlines, 12-16 flat colors, clean geometric square pixels, no gradients or fine texture.
Three columns × six rows. Original fixed cell layout and foot/ground baseline retained. Standing character body about the same height as input skeleton; staff may reach slightly above hood but always stays inside the cell. Keep all hands, staff, spells and sparks inside each cell with transparent gutters. Actual transparent PNG: blank pixels outside sprites exactly alpha zero. No floor or shadow, no checkerboard, no visible grid lines, no words, no other complete characters, no color noise or glow haze in empty background.
Rows, left to right THREE genuinely DIFFERENT time poses:
1 IDLE: staff upright and right hand tucked; skull and shoulders hover 1 logical pixel up; hover settles. Cloak is compact.
2 WALK / HOVER: robe tips trail left as body drifts right; robe hangs directly down in neutral position; robe tips swing right with bony hand/shoulder shift. SAME body scale, staff retained.
3 ATTACK / SUMMON CAST: bony right hand drawn into chest and staff tilted forward (windup); staff lifted and RIGHT hand extended forward, palm facing right with a compact violet skull-shaped spell at fingertip (release); hand sweeps down, staff returns upright, three separated square violet sparks (recovery). Strong different arm positions. This animation must read as actively SUMMONING and casting.
4 HURT: recoils backward, hood tilts and staff angles away; crouched robe and bent torso; recovers upright.
5 DEATH: kneeling collapsing cloak; fallen hood, skull and folded cloak at ground; only a low skull-and-bones pile with dark robe and dropped staff.
6 SPAWN / BONE SUMMON: low ivory bone pile and folded robe inside a tiny segmented violet magic ring; torso, hood and skull are half-reassembled rising from pile with staff lifting; full standing necromancer, ring disappears and two violet square sparks fade.
Every standing frame has consistent bottom baseline and body scale. Left-right mirroring should be usable. Originality: create a new character; do not reproduce any commercial necromancer sprite. Entire sprite sheet clean transparent, no embedded labels.
